# serocalculator

> Estimating Infection Rates from Serological Data

## Reference

- [analyze_sims()](https://ucd-serg.github.io/serocalculator/man/analyze_sims.html): Analyze simulation results
- [antibody_decay_curve()](https://ucd-serg.github.io/serocalculator/man/antibody_decay_curve.html): Antibody decay curve with natural parameters
- [as_noise_params()](https://ucd-serg.github.io/serocalculator/man/as_noise_params.html): Load noise parameters
- [as_pop_data()](https://ucd-serg.github.io/serocalculator/man/as_pop_data.html): Load a cross-sectional antibody survey data set
- [as_sr_params()](https://ucd-serg.github.io/serocalculator/man/as_sr_params.html): Load longitudinal seroresponse parameters
- [autoplot.curve_params](https://ucd-serg.github.io/serocalculator/man/autoplot.curve_params.html): Graph antibody decay curves by antigen isotype
- [autoplot.pop_data](https://ucd-serg.github.io/serocalculator/man/autoplot.pop_data.html): Plot distribution of antibodies
- [autoplot.seroincidence](https://ucd-serg.github.io/serocalculator/man/autoplot.seroincidence.html): Plot the log-likelihood curve for the incidence rate estimate
- [autoplot.seroincidence.by](https://ucd-serg.github.io/serocalculator/man/autoplot.seroincidence.by.html): Plot `seroincidence.by` log-likelihoods
- [autoplot.sim_results](https://ucd-serg.github.io/serocalculator/man/autoplot.sim_results.html): Plot simulation results `autoplot()` method for `sim_results` objects
- [autoplot.summary.seroincidence.by](https://ucd-serg.github.io/serocalculator/man/autoplot.summary.seroincidence.by.html): Plot method for `summary.seroincidence.by` objects
- [check_pop_data()](https://ucd-serg.github.io/serocalculator/man/check_pop_data.html): Check the formatting of a cross-sectional antibody survey dataset.
- [compare_seroincidence()](https://ucd-serg.github.io/serocalculator/man/compare_seroincidence.html): Compare seroincidence rates between two groups
- [curve_app()](https://ucd-serg.github.io/serocalculator/man/curve_app.html): Launch the interactive Shiny app for the antigen-antibody kinetics model
- [est_seroincidence()](https://ucd-serg.github.io/serocalculator/man/est_seroincidence.html): Find the maximum likelihood estimate of the incidence rate parameter
- [est_seroincidence_by()](https://ucd-serg.github.io/serocalculator/man/est_seroincidence_by.html): Estimate Seroincidence
- [est_seroincidence_by_cached()](https://ucd-serg.github.io/serocalculator/man/est_seroincidence_by_cached.html): Estimate seroincidence by stratum, caching the result on disk
- [example_noise_params_pk](https://ucd-serg.github.io/serocalculator/man/example_noise_params_pk.html): Small example of noise parameters for typhoid
- [example_noise_params_sees](https://ucd-serg.github.io/serocalculator/man/example_noise_params_sees.html): Small example of noise parameters for typhoid
- [get_biomarker_levels()](https://ucd-serg.github.io/serocalculator/man/get_biomarker_levels.html): Extract biomarker levels
- [get_biomarker_names_var()](https://ucd-serg.github.io/serocalculator/man/get_biomarker_names_var.html): Get biomarker variable name
- [get_values()](https://ucd-serg.github.io/serocalculator/man/get_values.html): Get antibody measurement values
- [get_values_var()](https://ucd-serg.github.io/serocalculator/man/get_values_var.html): Extract antibody measurement values
- [graph.curve.params()](https://ucd-serg.github.io/serocalculator/man/graph.curve.params.html): Graph estimated antibody decay curves
- [graph_loglik()](https://ucd-serg.github.io/serocalculator/man/graph_loglik.html): Graph log-likelihood of data
- [load_noise_params()](https://ucd-serg.github.io/serocalculator/man/load_noise_params.html): Load noise parameters
- [load_pop_data()](https://ucd-serg.github.io/serocalculator/man/load_pop_data.html): Load a cross-sectional antibody survey data set
- [load_sr_params()](https://ucd-serg.github.io/serocalculator/man/load_sr_params.html): Load longitudinal seroresponse parameter samples
- [log_likelihood()](https://ucd-serg.github.io/serocalculator/man/log_likelihood.html): Calculate log-likelihood
- [pathogen_decay_curve()](https://ucd-serg.github.io/serocalculator/man/pathogen_decay_curve.html): Pathogen decay curve
- [plot_decay_curve()](https://ucd-serg.github.io/serocalculator/man/plot_decay_curve.html): Plot a decay function
- [refit_strata()](https://ucd-serg.github.io/serocalculator/man/refit_strata.html): Re-fit a subset of strata, with log-likelihood graphs attached
- [sees_pop_data_100](https://ucd-serg.github.io/serocalculator/man/sees_pop_data_100.html): Small example cross-sectional data set
- [sees_pop_data_pk_100](https://ucd-serg.github.io/serocalculator/man/sees_pop_data_pk_100.html): Small example cross-sectional data set
- [sees_typhoid_ests_strat](https://ucd-serg.github.io/serocalculator/man/sees_typhoid_ests_strat.html): Example `"seroincidence.by"` object
- [serocalculator_example()](https://ucd-serg.github.io/serocalculator/man/serocalculator_example.html): Get path to an example file
- [sim_pop_data()](https://ucd-serg.github.io/serocalculator/man/sim_pop_data.html): Simulate a cross-sectional serosurvey with noise
- [sim_pop_data_multi()](https://ucd-serg.github.io/serocalculator/man/sim_pop_data_multi.html): Simulate multiple data sets
- [sim_pop_data_multi_cached()](https://ucd-serg.github.io/serocalculator/man/sim_pop_data_multi_cached.html): Simulate multiple data sets, caching the result on disk
- [strata()](https://ucd-serg.github.io/serocalculator/man/strata.html): Extract `Strata` metadata from an object
- [summary.seroincidence](https://ucd-serg.github.io/serocalculator/man/summary.seroincidence.html): Summarizing fitted seroincidence models
- [summary.seroincidence.by](https://ucd-serg.github.io/serocalculator/man/summary.seroincidence.by.html): Summary Method for `"seroincidence.by"` Objects
- [typhoid_curves_nostrat_100](https://ucd-serg.github.io/serocalculator/man/typhoid_curves_nostrat_100.html): Small example of antibody response curve parameters for typhoid
